newsitem.title: USA: FSA has capacity for Utah, Wash., and Ill. issues.
newsitem.headline: FSA has capacity for Utah, Wash., and Ill. issues.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday it had secondary market insurance capacity for the following issues:
--Inter-Mountain Power Agency, Utah, power supply revenue bonds, junior and senior liens.
--Washington Public Power Supply System revenue bonds projects 1, 2 and 3 only.
--Illinois Health Facility Authority, Advocate Health Care Network refunding and revenue bonds series 1997A.
Insurance is available on maturities 2007 and longer, FSA said. Capacity is available on a first-come, first-served basis. For more information, call 212-826-0601.
